title: What will be said the most during the Global Chess League Final?
description:
Pick the word you think gets said most. $1 per word in USDC, pick as many as you like. The most-said word wins and holders split the pool.

Transcript taken from September 13th

Rules:

Counting runs from the first move of the first game until the final game concludes.

If it mishears a word, usually a name, we go by what was actually said.
One pick per word per wallet.

title: What will be said the most during the Adobe earnings call?
description:
Pick the word you think gets said most. $1 per word in USDC, pick as many as you like. The most-said word wins and holders split the pool.

Rules:

Counting runs from beginning of the call to the end.
